other_conditions: Must be an existing State Level Entrepreneurship Development Institute (EDI) owned and controlled by a State Government or Union Territory; new EDIs are not eligible
Private training institutions and NGOs are excluded from eligibility for infrastructure support and training programmes
Costs of land, construction of staff quarters, etc., are not eligible for assistance
Assistance for State Level EDIs is capped at ₹3.00 Crore per institute
The assisted EDI must complete construction within the stipulated timeframe and submit a utilization certificate as per the sanction letter
Proposals must be submitted to the Deputy Secretary/Director (EDI), Ministry of MSME, New Delhi
The scheme may impose additional conditions as prescribed by the Central Government before sanctioning assistance
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹3 crore per state‑level EDI for infrastructure development, equipment procurement, and faculty training.
